description: For someone buying a buffer ETF partway through its outcome period: remaining upside to the cap, how far the index must fall before the buffer starts, and how much buffer is left, given the index and fund moves since the period began. Same math as https://www.vistashares.com/buffer-etf-mid-period-calculator/.

buffer_pct.description: Buffer size for the full period, in percent. Accepts 0 to 100; default 10.

cap_pct.description: Cap for the full period, in percent. Accepts 0 to 200; default 12.

fund_change_pct.description: Fund value change since the period started, in percent. Accepts -90 to 200; default 3.

index_change_pct.description: Index change since the period started, in percent. Accepts -90 to 200; default 5.

name: buffer_mid_period
title: Buffer ETF mid-period calculator
